hook: FA demands Infantino release World Cup sell-off documents

body.voiceover: FA chair Debbie Hewitt sent a letter demanding Fifa president Gianni Infantino release all documents on his plan to sell off a stake in the World Cup. Hewitt, a Fifa vice-president, wants a written explanation for the cancelled suspension of USA forward Folarin Balogun, and documents released before the Fifa Council meets on October 15. Her letter also calls for an independent review of the scrapped sell-off plan, and accuses Fifa of governance failures. England, Wales and Scotland have withdrawn support for Infantino's re-election bid.
